This video is a brilliant visual exploration of Counterfactual Thinking and Regret Bias. Our brains are hardwired to ruminate on the past, falsely believing that if we could just alter previous inputs, our lives would be friction-free. But as the ending reveals, chasing perfection is a trap. True psychological peace doesn't come from erasing past mistakes with hindsight; it comes from learning how to live with uncertainty in the present.

On Irrational Minds, we break down the research behind these cognitive biases and mental loops—for anyone curious about how our brains deal with regret and choice. 😊
